'''Ceptor''' was a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who served during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Ceptor oversaw the [[Battle of Rordak]] from a [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]], but the Republic commander [[Bouris Ulgo]] personally boarded Ceptor's ship and captured it, ensuring a Republic victory.<ref name="Usurper" />
